reviews.trigger: User-requested whole-problem review after extensive leapfrog exploration and two methodology corrections

levels.target: For 234446.a1, prove ord_{s=1} L(E,s)=rank E(Q)=4: certify exact L''(E,1)=0, then nonzero fourth derivative.
levels.proved: Algebraic rank four and known functional-equation/root sign are documented by LMFDB. Rank-zero theorems rule out nonzero L(E,1), giving L(E,1)=L'(E,1)=0.
levels.missing: An exact proof of L''(E,1)=0. Independent certified nonzero fourth derivative is also not yet established; PARI numerical value is evidence only.

levels.target: After exact rank four, prove Sha(E/Q) finite and normalized L^{(4)}(E,1)/4! equals Omega*Reg*|Sha|*Tamagawa/torsion^2.
levels.proved: LMFDB reports numerical Omega, Reg, Tamagawa product 2, torsion order 1, and analytic Sha ratio approximately 1; these are data, not proof of the full formula.
levels.missing: No proof that Sha is finite or trivial, or that the displayed numerical coefficient equality is exact.

levels.target: Prove rank equality, Sha finiteness and leading coefficient formula for all elliptic curves over Q (and articulate any extension to other fields separately).
levels.proved: Our project has no new general theorem; published rank-zero/one and Iwasawa results are prior art.
levels.missing: A general unconditional argument beyond special known cases; no proposed leapfrog currently supplies it.

reviews.confirmed_project_outputs: Exact local split-11 logarithm residue data with independent PARI; conditional exact-rational twist-derivative interval; negative controls for confusing p-adic augmentations, one-prime Selmer and complex L'', and a reproducible research harness. These do not establish new BSD implications.
reviews.decisive_missing_arrow: No proved implication from four rational point directions / derived Kato augmentation / anticyclotomic p-adic heights / higher Heegner cycles to exact complex L''(234446.a1,1)=0.
reviews.failed_routes: Naive C2 third augmentation layer is vacuous; reduction modulo 11 of scalar norm produces false deep vanishing; cyclic first-layer zero misses 11*T^3; Mazur–Tate 2025 theorem assumes BSD and cannot be applied backwards; two-prime local-log kernel is not the one-prime modified Selmer group or height radical.
reviews.prior_art_vs_new: Analytic-rank numerical classification and approximate BSD ratio are already in LMFDB; rank4 Mordell–Weil points and reductions are known. Our independently reproduced exact code, test harness, method corrections and bibliography audits are project outputs, not newly discovered theorems.

routes.assessment: BKS derived Kato I³ is an algebraic augmentation condition, not complex L'' vanishing; both the finiteness assumption and a comparison map are missing.
routes.next_test: Check whether a provable noncircular complex-derivative map is known before computing cohomology classes in Q1/Q2.

routes.assessment: True global anticyclotomic height is not yet constructed; missing comparison from p-adic to complex L''.
routes.next_test: Produce an exact typed map or local/global Selmer-complex data sheet; no large computations until then.

routes.assessment: The base-change cubic derivative factorization is exact; no geometric theorem forces cubic vanishing.
routes.next_test: Locate a published higher-derivative geometric theorem with relevant hypotheses or write a precise unsolved lemma; a third twist derivative computation alone is insufficient.

routes.assessment: Finite congruences do not prove complex equality and Mazur–Tate 2025 route assumed BSD.
routes.next_test: Only resume upon discovering a noncircular period comparison.

routes.assessment: PARI numerics support order four but exact zero is not established.
routes.next_test: Consider a certified nonzero fourth derivative only if it forms part of a reviewed rank-four proof route; avoid further isolated precision sweeps.

routes.assessment: No geometric operator beyond ordinary completed L parity has been defined.
routes.next_test: Resume only with an explicit period/cohomology operator and rank-two negative control.

reviews.next_decisive_question: Is there a *published and hypothesis-applicable* geometric/derived-Euler-system theorem furnishing a non-circular complex L'' vanishing implication from arithmetic rank at least four, or a minimal additional lemma whose proof is feasible?
reviews.next_action: Prepare a theorem-direction literature chart comparing derived Kato, higher Gross–Zagier/Heegner, and direct L-derivative criteria, marking output objects and every circular assumption; prioritize a counter-control on rank-two curves.
reviews.decision: Reduce unproductive p-adic layer calculations unless they test an explicit link to the original complex derivative. Maintain small parallel Sha/strong-BSD lane and an explicit generalization test.
reviews.nonclaims: No proof of BSD, of complex analytic rank four for 234446.a1, of Tate–Shafarevich finiteness, or of a previously unknown general theorem.
